title: Eleven Lines Given Back
subtitle: 语境与上下文 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语境与上下文（语言与思维·语境与语篇）
meta: 主题语境：语境与上下文（语言与思维·语境与语篇）　|　核心词汇：context　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 context 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 my teacher ① quoted a line out of context and then put it back, and she said the putting back was the whole of the lesson. The ② context, meaning the surrounding and not the word, was eleven lines long and stayed that length; context, she said, is the only thing in a quotation that is judged by how much of it is given back.

Every ③ context in that chapter had the same footnote, and the ④ context at the end, meaning the one she kept for the exam and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever copied twice. Context, my mother said, is nine parts footnote and one part somebody willing to read around; my teacher said the reading around is the part that fills eleven lines.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ context was the whole of the decision, meaning the background and not the quotation. The ⑥ context, meaning the background and not any of that, is the only thing in a decision that everybody assumes and nobody states; context, he said, is either something you quote from or the only word that means both a surrounding and a background. She said the background is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ context had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the footnote. The ⑧ context of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in June, was one quotation and thirty years of reading around; context, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to give it back. He said the giving back was never mentioned.

The ⑨ context I remember is the one at the end, which she gave back in 1981 and is still described as the longest in the school. A ⑩ context, my mother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being read around; every context, she said, is a background that has agreed to look like a surrounding. She said the background was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 语境（指那段上下文本身，与那个词相对）
C. 固定搭配：out of context 脱离语境
D. n. 语境（指那一章里每一处）
E. n. 语境（指末尾那一处）
F. n. 背景；环境（抽象：事情发生的背景）
G. n. 语境（指笔记里提到的那一处）
H. n. 语境（抽象总称，语境这一概念）

items.q: quoted a line out of context and then put it back
The context, meaning the surrounding and not the word
context was the whole of the decision
the context had become a line in a notebook
The context of the whole thing
A context, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: out of context 意为“脱离语境”，1967 年老师脱离语境引了一行，然后又把它放回了原文。
context 意为“语境”，指那段上下文本身而不是那个词，有十一行那么长。
context 指那一章里每一处语境，每一处都带着同样的脚注。
context 指末尾那一处（她留给考试的那处），是唯一有人抄过两次的。
context 意为“背景、环境”，父亲说背景就是那个决定的全部，指的是事情发生的背景而不是那段引文。
context 为抽象用法，指那份背景而不是那段引文，是决定里人人都默认、却无人明说的东西。
context 意为“语境”，指笔记里提到的那一处，到 1975 年这处语境成了笔记里的一行。
context 意为“语境”，老师六月写道，整件事的语境是一段引文三十年的前后阅读。
context 意为“语境、上下文”，我记得的是末尾那一处，她 1981 年还原的，至今仍被说成全校最长的。
context 为抽象总称，母亲说一段语境是唯一会因为被前后阅读而变好的东西。

那段语境，指的是那段上下文本身而不是那个词，有十一行那么长，并且一直是那个长度。（context）

末尾那一处语境，指的是她留给考试的那处，是唯一有人抄过两次的。（context）
父亲说背景就是那个决定的全部，指的是事情发生的背景而不是那段引文。（context）

Every context in that chapter had the same footnote.
The context at the end, meaning the one she kept for the exam and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever copied twice.
